title: No evidence-gated learning: improvements were manual/global and injected everywhere with no approval

rcca.root_cause: Only a human-curated generalized RCCA wrote learnings; no capture from review/defects/media-QA/quality, no candidate/approval stage, and learnings injected globally into every agent/project.
rcca.corrective: core/learning_synth.py: collect evidence -> propose scoped candidates -> approval (API/HIL) promotes into the OWNER store via its API. Static instructions untouched; API-first (/api/v1/learning/candidates*).
rcca.preventive: Evidence-gated (no evidence => no candidate); approval-based (no auto-injection); default scope project/area; global only by deliberate promotion; reversible+audited.
